# Psalm 130 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 130:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-song of-the-ascents. From-the-depths I-have-called-you O-YHWH.
- **LOGOS:** A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD!
- **PNEUMA:** A song for the journey to Jerusalem. From the deepest pit I cry out to you, LORD!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 130:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For with-you the-forgiveness, so-that you-will-be-feared.
- **LOGOS:** But with you there is forgiveness, that you may be feared.
- **PNEUMA:** But you offer forgiveness, and that's why people worship you.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 130:5 (overlap: 7%)

- **EMET:** I-wait-for YHWH, waits my-soul, and-in-his-word I-hope.
- **LOGOS:** I wait for the LORD, my soul waits, and in his word I hope;
- **PNEUMA:** I wait for the LORD — my whole soul waits — and I put my hope in his word.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 130:6 (overlap: 9%)

- **EMET:** My-soul for-the-Lord more-than-watchmen for-the-morning, watchmen for-the-morning.
- **LOGOS:** my soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
- **PNEUMA:** I long for the Lord more than night watchmen long for the dawn — more than watchmen long for the morning!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 130:7 (overlap: 11%)

- **EMET:** Hope O-Israel in-YHWH, for with-YHWH the-steadfast-love, and-abundant with-him redemption.
- **LOGOS:** O Israel, hope in the LORD! For with the LORD there is steadfast love, and with him is plentiful redemption.
- **PNEUMA:** Israel, put your hope in the LORD! For the LORD's love never fails, and his power to save is enormous.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 130:2 (overlap: 11%)

- **EMET:** O-Lord hear my-voice; let-be your-ears attentive to-voice-of my-supplications.
- **LOGOS:** O Lord, hear my voice! Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my pleas for mercy!
- **PNEUMA:** Lord, hear my voice! Please listen to my desperate pleas!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
